title: Tell us what HP tests: the hosted site or the v2.1 HTML prototype?
bluf: HP's UAT pack (367 cases, none run) tests the v2.1 HTML prototype, not our hosted site. Of 285 functional cases, 111 match the site, 48 partly, 126 are missing (about 80 are a sales layer: pipeline, quotes, contracts). The pass rule is 100% of P0/P1 cases, and 98 of those cannot pass today. Recommend we test the hosted site and defer the prototype-only cases with a signed deferral each. Default if you do not tap: Tuesday holds UAT and sends nothing to anyone, at 10:00 AEDT today (2026-11-10).

title: Refuse invisible and text-direction characters in customer names and file names?
bluf: A customer name can contain hidden or text-direction characters (even a name of only U+200B), and the client sees and prints it. The same family: file-name checks refuse some names Windows allows (LPT plus superscript 4). Recommend: refuse invisible, control and direction characters in customer names, as comments already do, and for file names fold width and white space only (stops the over-refusals). Default if you do not tap: option C (change nothing), at 10:00 AEDT today (2026-11-10).
